unverified: Only a 1-variable fetch (psl) was run. The 72-variable list is CorrDiffCMIP6's 74 inputs (HF checkpoint metadata, copied from specs/CMIP6MultiRealm.json; no checkpoint loaded here) filtered to CMIP6 variable ids present in the ESGF 'day' table catalog for CanESM5/ssp585/r1i1p2f1; availability of every requested pressure level (10-1000 hPa) in the day-table files was not checked.
notes: Single-realm slice of the CorrDiffCMIP6 pairing: the model reads CMIP6MultiRealm([CMIP6(table_id=t) for t in ('day','Eday','SIday')]) (corrdiff_cmip6.py:145-152); this spec is the 'day' realm, which serves 72 of the 74 inputs (ts is only in Eday, siconc only in SIday).

WARNING: whole-period NetCDF files are downloaded per CMIP6 variable (36 day-table files incl. 3D ta/ua/va/zg/hus/wap); the model docstring quotes ~60 GB for the three realms, so a full cold trial is tens of GB.
Time must be 12:00 UTC for daily tables with exact_time_match=true (corrdiff_cmip6.py:155); ssp585 covers 2015-2100. The model also requests lead times -24h/0/+24h; this spec fetches one time only.
Constructor does an ESGF catalog search (network) and is included in timing.
